verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer documents its own browser capability. It can search and browse the web, including login-gated pages, and it can run browser tasks across dozens of URLs in parallel with structured output. That covers the research half of the story well. Completing tasks on websites is only implied by the phrase "browser tasks" and is not explicitly documented as clicking, form-filling or submitting transactions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of interactive website actions (navigation, form entry, purchases or submissions), independent or hands-on corroboration of browser-driven task completion.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites

citations.quote: Search and browse the web for real-time information, including login-gated pages
Run browser tasks across dozens of URLs in parallel, collecting results into structured output.
Take high-fidelity screenshots of any webpage.
